name: Maybe Next Year...
source:
Two college students suffer through trauma, guilt, anxiety, and jealousy during the last day of finals before graduation. 

[From [url=https://pltn.itch.io/maybe]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
畢業前最後一次期末考試的最後一天，兩名大學生在創傷、內疚、焦慮和嫉妒中煎熬。
